items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Sophie Tucker appears only in a parenthetical note by the transcriber/boilerplate, not in the interviewee's spoken response.

ctx.x: Not really because "Loch Lomond" has sort of gotten me out of a bad situation on alot of occasions because you know, if you sing standard pop tunes okay, but if there is anybody there who know that you do "Loch Lomond" - in fact, invirably, If I appear someplace the publicity always says, "The 'Loch Lomond' Girl". So they expect to hear "Loch Lomond". And I suppose if they didn't have the "Loch Lomond Girl" then I wouldn't be the attraction. You got to have some reason to be there. There are singers and…
Sophie Tucker's "Some Of These Days" is her theme song.
